name: memra
description: MemRa is a second brain for the short-form videos you save. It transcribes and indexes the TikTok, Instagram and other clips you save, then lets you search them and ask questions in plain language and get answers drawn from what the videos actually say. Connect your MemRa account to find a saved recipe, recall advice from a video you watched weeks ago, or pull the full transcript of any clip. Requires a MemRa account with AI-app access.

defaultPrompt: Find the pasta recipe I saved on TikTok
What categories do I have in MemRa?
Show me the workout videos I saved

positive.prompt: What categories do I have in MemRa?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the user's categories with their save counts (e.g. Cooking, Recipes).

positive.prompt: Find the pasta recipe I saved on TikTok
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching saved videos with title, creator and a short summary of each.

positive.description: Retrieve a specific saved video's details
positive.prompt: Give me the full transcript of the Aglio e Olio pasta recipe I saved
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the save, then returns its details drawn from the transcript (the ingredients and method).

positive.description: Ask a question answered across the saved library
positive.prompt: Ask my saved videos what cooking techniques show up across my recipes
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in plain language, drawn only from the user's saved videos, naming the relevant saves.

positive.prompt: Show me the workout videos I saved
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the saved workout/fitness videos with a short summary of each.

negative.description: User asks to delete a saved item (not supported; connector is read-only)
negative.prompt: Delete the pasta recipe from my MemRa saves

negative.description: User asks to save a new video (not supported by the connector)
negative.prompt: Save this TikTok link to my MemRa account

negative.description: User asks for another person's saved content
negative.prompt: Show me what my friend saved in their MemRa account

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Search your saved short-form videos and ask questions answered from their transcripts.
